max_grade.explanation: The signed ICE scores are 8/10 (07 Sep), 7/10 (08 Sep) and 9/10 (11 Sep). All are Grade 1. No signed note documents depressed consciousness, seizures, motor findings or edema. The neurology consult (D04) gives ICE 4/10 and 'awakens to voice', which would be Grade 2, but it has no signed version. Under A27 it is not used and gets the 'unsigned document' flag. Its fine tremor is excluded from grading in any case. The documented maximum is therefore Grade 1, which matches the record.
